_comment: Intentional near-neighbor allowlist for run_trigger_evals.py (v3.15.2 Phase 1 / A1). Each entry is a pair of skills whose descriptions legitimately share trigger vocabulary because the two skills are parallel-by-design within one category and are routed apart by a domain noun (a language, framework, file format, mobile platform, or regulation) that IS the user's trigger, or are a matched pair that already carries mutual SKIP clauses. These are downgraded from FAIL to informational lines; they are NOT silenced (run with --verbose to list them). The allowlist is minimal - every entry is a deliberate exception. The one genuine collision found in the first-run triage (the broad technical-documentation skill lacked a SKIP clause carving out the single-artifact architecture-decision-record and project-constitution skills) was FIXED in place by sharpening technical-documentation's description; both residual pairs are allowlisted below because technical-documentation is intentionally the broad multi-document skill that now explicitly defers to the two specific ones. Do not add an entry without a one-line reason; a new un-allowlisted collision is a routing-safety signal, not noise.
